name: SWI/SNF related BAF chromatin remodeling complex subunit ATPase 4

function.text: SMARCA4 encodes BRG1, an ATP-dependent catalytic subunit of SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling complexes that regulate nucleosome organization and gene expression.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Coffin-Siris syndrome (autosomal dominant); rhabdoid tumor predisposition syndrome 2 (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Lung adenocarcinoma; Sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma; SMARCA4-deficient uterine sarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
